scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy --env staging --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)}
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler deploy --env production --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)}
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
